messages:
Priya: Quick sanity check — GA tomorrow AM. Are we green on the narrow last-minute items: SLA doc updates, support runbook, staging smoke test pass/fail criteria, pricing FAQ, and alert thresholds? Need yes/no + owner. :pray:
Alex: SLA doc updated, but waiting on legal ack for two lines in SLO exceptions. Assigned to me, pinging legal.
Ben: Support runbook has a couple of TODOs: PGP rotation note missing, and runbook has steps for canary abort but not a concrete rollback sequence after a latency spike. I can add those today.
Maya: Observability burn-in looks OK — traces and token-level latency dashboards are in. One missing alert: "token_latency_p90 > 1s sustained for 5m" is not yet in the alert rules. Who owns thresholds?
Priya: @Alex please chase legal. @Maya add a proposed threshold and I'll sign off if it's conservative. Ben please add rollback steps and link to the runbook in the Console.
Alex: Pinged legal (legal@). They asked for the exact wording for the SLO exception clause. Will post suggested wording in 30–90m.
Ben: Adding rollback section now. Drafting example commands below so oncall has copy/paste:
```
# canary rollback
redwoodctl rollout abort --canary-id $CANARY
redwoodctl deploy promote --version last-known-good
```
Also adding a short checklist: notify oncall -> abort canary -> rollback -> validate smoke flows.
Maya: I propose the alert be: token_latency_p90 > 1200ms for 10m OR error_rate > 1% for 5m. That gives headroom for transient noise but catches sustained regressions.
Sam: (oncall) Strong +1 for the customer-impact mapping in runbook — include which accounts to call and escalation emails. I can draft the table. Also, for longchat failures we need a decision: block GA or ship with documented limits?
Priya: Good point. I want to avoid an unnecessary block. If longchat fails at >8k tokens consistently, we should document the limit, add a prominent note in SDKs/docs, and proceed, provided short and medium chat flows pass. If it's flaky under expected production load, then we block.
docs-bot: New runbook draft uploaded: /docs/runbooks/ga-support-runbook-v1.md — Ben and Sam have edit access.
Alex: I'll take pricing FAQ bullets: one on burst autoscale cost behavior and one on committed capacity discounts. Will post PR in docs repo in ~1h.
Sam: Staging smoke checklist (my run): shortchat OK, embeddings bulk upload OK, longchat hits kv-cache OOM at ~8.5k tokens — stacktrace in logs: `kv_cache_alloc: out of memory`.
Ben: If OOM is isolated to the staging config, we can tweak cache config for GA, but if it's model-level need to call the runtime team. I'll coordinate.
Priya: Owners recap: Alex -> legal wording + pricing FAQ; Ben -> runbook rollback + console link; Maya -> finalize alert thresholds and create dashboard link; Sam -> customer-impact table + run smoke longchat again after Ben's change. Recheck thread at 12:30pm with status. If anything looks blocking before then, flag with :rotating_light:.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for 2026-03-21T22:00Z — will only proceed after manual GO from #product by Priya.
Priya: Thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. Let's keep this tight and only escalate real blockers. See you at 12:30. :thumbsup:
